name: SVGEF Grants

funder.name: St Vincent and the Grenadines Environment Fund

summary: Grants from a local environment fund for fieldwork, community engagement and other conservation projects in St Vincent and the Grenadines, mainly marine, species and community-led work.

calls.label: Quarterly application periods

status.quote: Applications for grants will be accepted in 4 periods per year, and specifically every January, April, July and October.

recurring.quote: Applications for grants will be accepted in 4 periods per year, and specifically every January, April, July and October.

calls.recurring: Application periods every January, April, July and October.

applicant_types.quote: WHO: Local non-profit organizations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and/or other local bodies, including research centers, are highly recommended to apply for grants.

geography.quote: Please note we DO NOT provide funding for projects outside St. Vincent and the Grenadines.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and send our application form.
